anchor the team: As the most experienced player, Kevin helps anchor the team on defense and stays calm under pressure.
身為最有經驗的球員，凱文在防守上幫忙穩住團隊，而且在壓力下保持冷靜。
anchor the news: My aunt has worked at the TV station for ten years, and now she anchors the news every evening.
我阿姨在電視台工作了十年，現在她每天晚上主播新聞。
anchored in research: The new teaching method is firmly anchored in research, so parents can trust that it really works.
這個新的教學法穩固地以研究為基礎，所以家長可以相信它真的有效。
anchor a discussion in facts: The teacher reminded us to anchor a discussion in facts rather than in rumors we read online.
老師提醒我們要使討論立基於事實，而不是我們在網路上讀到的謠言。
anticipate problems: Good planners anticipate problems before they happen, so they always have a backup plan ready.
好的規劃者會在問題發生前預料會有問題，所以他們總是準備好備案。
anticipate demand: Before the Lunar New Year, stores try to anticipate demand and order extra snacks and gifts.
農曆新年前，商店會試著預估需求，並多訂一些零食和禮品。
anticipate someone's needs: A great waiter can anticipate customers' needs and refill their water before they even ask.
一位很棒的服務生能預先設想顧客的需求，在他們開口之前就幫他們加水。
eagerly anticipate the trip: The students eagerly anticipate the trip to Japan and talk about it every day during lunch.
學生們熱切期待去日本的旅行，每天午餐時都在談論它。
appeal to young people: The new phone's bright colors and cool design appeal to young people, so it sells well among teenagers.
這款新手機鮮豔的顏色和酷炫的設計吸引年輕人，所以在青少年之間賣得很好。
appeal for help: After the earthquake, the city government appealed for help from other countries on TV and online.
地震之後，市政府在電視和網路上向其他國家呼籲援助。
appeal to reason: Instead of shouting, the teacher tried to appeal to reason and calmly explained why the rule mattered.
老師沒有大吼，而是試著訴諸理性，冷靜地解釋這條規定為什麼重要。
appeal the decision: The player plans to appeal the decision, believing the referee made a serious mistake in the final match.
這名球員打算對判決提出上訴，因為他認為裁判在決賽中犯了嚴重的錯誤。
appeal to one's sense of duty: The poster appeals to people's sense of duty, reminding citizens that voting is their responsibility.
這張海報喚起人們的責任感，提醒公民投票是他們的責任。
appoint a manager: The company will appoint a manager next week to lead its new office in Kaohsiung.
公司下週將任命一位經理，來帶領它在高雄的新辦公室。
appoint a date: The two sides agreed to appoint a date for the next meeting before the end of the month.
雙方同意在月底前訂定下次會議的日期。
be appointed to a position: She was appointed to a position on the school board because of her many years of teaching experience.
她因為多年的教學經驗而被任命為學校董事會的職位。
approve the budget: Lawmakers must approve the budget before the government can spend money on new roads and schools.
立法委員必須先核准預算，政府才能花錢在新的道路和學校上。
approve of one's choice: At first, her parents did not approve of her choice to study art instead of medicine.
一開始，她的父母不贊同她選擇念藝術而不念醫學。
approve a plan: The city council finally voted to approve a plan to build a new park near the train station.
市議會終於投票批准在火車站附近興建新公園的計畫。
a problem arises: Whenever a problem arises at work, Amy stays calm and looks for a practical solution first.
每當工作上出現問題時，艾咪都會保持冷靜，先找出實際可行的解決辦法。
arise from poverty: Many health problems in the village arise from poverty, as families cannot afford healthy food or doctors.
這個村莊的許多健康問題源於貧窮，因為家庭負擔不起健康的食物或看醫生。
should the need arise: Keep some cash in your bag, so you can take a taxi home should the need arise.
在包包裡放一些現金，這樣若有需要你就可以搭計程車回家。
arouse interest: The science teacher's fun experiments aroused interest in chemistry among even the quietest students.
自然老師有趣的實驗甚至引起了最安靜學生對化學的興趣。
arouse suspicion: The man's strange behavior near the bank aroused suspicion, so a guard called the police.
那名男子在銀行附近的奇怪舉動引起懷疑，所以一名警衛報了警。
arouse public anger: The decision to cut down the old trees in the park aroused public anger across the city.
砍掉公園裡老樹的決定在全市激起民怨。
arouse curiosity: The mysterious title of the novel is meant to arouse curiosity and make readers want to open it.
這本小說神祕的書名是為了激發好奇心，讓讀者想要翻開它。
arrest the decline: The town hopes the new festival will arrest the decline in tourism that started several years ago.
這個小鎮希望新的節慶能遏止幾年前開始的觀光衰退。
arrest someone's attention: A loud scream from the street arrested my attention while I was reading in the living room.
我在客廳看書時，街上傳來的一聲尖叫吸引了我的注意。
arrest the spread of disease: Doctors worked day and night to arrest the spread of disease in the crowded camp.
醫生們日以繼夜地工作，以遏止疾病在擁擠的營區中蔓延。
